consumer: An engine condition/dialogue/mission check consuming u_has_item(knife_combat) over the avatar actor, asking the computed yes/no 'does this character possess a knife_combat'.
scope: only the character's own carried items (on-person: wielded/worn/inventory plus nested container contents via visit_items, excluding gun/magazine internals) -- a possession check, not a reachable-nearby objective.
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::conditional_t<T>::set_has_item (u_has_item/npc_has_item) -- its body returns the engine-computed predicate actor->charges_of(item_id) > 0 || actor->has_amount(item_id, 1), the authoritative yes/no, not a re-derivation from a raw item dump.
divergence: Avatar wields a gun whose contents hold a knife_combat-like item: visit_internal (visitable.cpp) skips gun/magazine contents, so the engine has_amount predicate correctly returns NOT carried, while a flat re-walk of the raw carried_items snapshot that descended into the gun would wrongly report carried.
